headline: John Cabang Tolentino Wins Asian Games Bronze in 110m Hurdles
seoTitle: John Cabang Tolentino Wins Asian Games 110m Hurdles Bronze | FMB News
seoDescription: John Cabang Tolentino won bronze in the 2026 Asian Games men's 110m hurdles with a season-best 13.48 seconds in Nagoya, Japan.
deck: The Paris Olympian clocked a season-best 13.48 seconds for third place in Nagoya, behind China's Chen Yuanjiang and Japan's Rachid Muratake.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: John Cabang Tolentino won bronze in the men's 110-meter hurdles final at the 2026 Asian Games in Nagoya, Japan.
He clocked 13.48 seconds, behind China's Chen Yuanjiang at 13.15 and Japan's Rachid Muratake at 13.29.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: GMA News reported that 13.48 seconds was Tolentino's season best and improved on his previous 13.63 mark.
He had finished fourth in the same event at the previous Asian Games.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The bronze was the Philippines' first athletics medal of the 2026 Asian Games.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Additional Philippine athletics events remain on the Asian Games program, and the overall medal count may change as competitions conclude.

Philippine News Agency independently reported the same podium order and times.
